{{Quote|The Crook, the Wook and Me. Volume two of my memoirs.''"<br />"''Who's a crook?|Leia Organa Solo telling Han Solo the title of her memoir|<ref name="Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
A '''memoir''' of at least two volumes in length was in the process of being written by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] around [[43 ABY]]. The work would have covered parts of Leia's life, but it also extended to the exploits of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] before she first met them. Leia decided the memoir's second volume would be titled ''[[The Crook, the Wook, and Me]]''. The seventh chapter of this volume would have covered Han and Chewbacca's [[mission to Dellalt]] where they uncovered the [[Treasure Vaults of Xim the Despot|treasure vault]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].<ref name="Falcon" />
